strategy.audience: Builders who use AI to develop and maintain products
strategy.problem: Product intent and delivery evidence become stale across development sessions
strategy.positioning: Portable product records linked to spec-driven development
strategy.review_trigger: Review after the scoped GitHub file integration

objectives.title: Keep product intent recoverable
objectives.metric: A builder can recover goals, current delivery state, and the next decision
objectives.baseline: Not measured in a real builder pilot
objectives.target: Demonstrate a complete product-development cycle and then evaluate it with builders
objectives.cohort: Local technical evaluation first; real builders not yet studied
guardrails: No silent overwrite of product intent
No claim of product value from code checks alone

opportunities.title: Keep the roadmap linked to implementation and outcomes
opportunities.source: Public Spec Loop system design in this repository
opportunities.experiment: Exercise local and GitHub file synchronization, then run a builder pilot
opportunities.stop_rule: Revise if conflicts lose intent or stale data is reported current

initiatives.title: Scoped GitHub product-file sync
initiatives.scope: Compare, merge, write, and verify one reviewed product JSON file through GitHub MCP
non_goals: No unverified deployment or product-value claims
initiatives.priority_reason: Follow the approved sequence and validate each integration before expanding it
initiatives.review_trigger: Review the observed result before the next commitment

initiatives.title: Continuous product review runner
initiatives.scope: Choose a runtime and validate scheduled reviews, freshness, missed runs, and cost limits
non_goals: No unverified deployment or product-value claims
initiatives.priority_reason: Follow the approved sequence and validate each integration before expanding it
initiatives.review_trigger: Review the observed result before the next commitment

initiatives.title: Codex installation and builder pilot
initiatives.scope: Validate actual plugin loading, repeated use, upgrade recovery, and builder outcomes
non_goals: No unverified deployment or product-value claims
initiatives.priority_reason: Follow the approved sequence and validate each integration before expanding it
initiatives.review_trigger: Review the observed result before the next commitment
